## Our Commitment 
## to Kashrut

For over 80 years, kashrut has been our first priority.

Our entire process is designed to produce the highest quality kosher poultry with each chicken and
turkey being inspected by our rabbis to ensure they meet our high standards.

[kashrut symbols@2x.png]
[[kashrut symbols@2x.png]][24]
[Learn more][25]

## from farm to table

For us, accountability and traceability begin even before the farm. We ensure the highest quality
care and kashrut standards are met from the very beginning…the egg. Empire is different than any
other kosher chicken company in the country, in that we hatch, grow, process, package and ship our
own products.

 

We are proud to be a company that supports family farms and raises chickens and turkeys with the
utmost care and respect.

[logo_6.png]

## our history

For more than 80 years, Empire Kosher has passionately pursued the vision of our founder, Joseph
Katz: To be the gold standard in kosher and help consumers do what is right and good and satisfying
for their families.

[Learn More][26]
[shutterstock_177342473.jpg]

## food

## safety

## 101

From handling raw poultry to cooking temperatures and safe storage, at Empire we want you to feel
confident preparing delicious and healthy meals. Here are a few helpful preparation and storage
suggestions from the USDA.

[More info][27]

[email_icon@2x.png]

Join our Empire family and get the inside scoop: news, exclusive recipes, exciting offers and more!

# André KRIEF est la marque de la société ANDRÉ KACHER leader du négoce, de la découpe, de la
# transformation et de la vente de produits carnés Kasher en France.

Une entreprise familiale pionnière de la modernisation de l’offre bouchère Kasher qui a su évoluer
et accompagner la transformation de ce marché. Nous exerçons notre métier de boucher avec passion
pour offrir, au plus grand nombre, la qualité, le service et le choix dans le strict respect des
règles de kashrout, de traçabilité et d’hygiène.

##### NOTRE GAMME DE PRODUITS

André KRIEF est la marque de la société ANDRÉ KACHER entreprise familiale, pionnière de la
modernisation de l’offre bouchère Kasher.

Nous sommes leader des produits carnés Kasher en France (négoce, découpe, transformation et vente).

Nous exerçons notre métier de boucher avec passion pour offrir, au plus grand nombre, la qualité, le
service et le choix. Nos équipes travaillent quotidiennement dans le strict respect des règles de
kashrout, de traçabilité et de sécurité alimentaire.

Notre offre.

L’enseigne André KRIEF propose une gamme très large en libre-service dans toutes les espèces : bœuf,
veau, agneau, poulet, poulet fermier, poule, dinde, canard, oie, chapon…ainsi que de nombreuses
spécialités de charcuteries cuites, sèches, sans oublier une large offre de produits de viandes
surgelées dont de nombreuses spécialités de viandes hachées 

Dans nos magasins vous trouverez l’essentiel des produits d’épicerie, un rayon traiteur et produits
laitiers, une cave avec de nombreux vins et alcools.  (« L’abus d’**alcool** est dangereux pour la
santé, à consommer avec modération »)

# André KRIEF est la marque de la société ANDRÉ KACHER leader du négoce, de la découpe, de la
# transformation et de la vente de produits carnés Kasher en France.

Une entreprise familiale pionnière de la modernisation de l’offre bouchère Kasher qui a su évoluer
et accompagner la transformation de ce marché. Nous exerçons notre métier de boucher avec passion
pour offrir, au plus grand nombre, la qualité, le service et le choix dans le strict respect des
règles de kashrout, de traçabilité et d’hygiène.

##### NOTRE GAMME DE PRODUITS

André KRIEF est la marque de la société ANDRÉ KACHER entreprise familiale, pionnière de la
modernisation de l’offre bouchère Kasher.

Nous sommes leader des produits carnés Kasher en France (négoce, découpe, transformation et vente).

Nous exerçons notre métier de boucher avec passion pour offrir, au plus grand nombre, la qualité, le
service et le choix. Nos équipes travaillent quotidiennement dans le strict respect des règles de
kashrout, de traçabilité et de sécurité alimentaire.

Notre offre.

L’enseigne André KRIEF propose une gamme très large en libre-service dans toutes les espèces : bœuf,
veau, agneau, poulet, poulet fermier, poule, dinde, canard, oie, chapon…ainsi que de nombreuses
spécialités de charcuteries cuites, sèches, sans oublier une large offre de produits de viandes
surgelées dont de nombreuses spécialités de viandes hachées 

Dans nos magasins vous trouverez l’essentiel des produits d’épicerie, un rayon traiteur et produits
laitiers, une cave avec de nombreux vins et alcools.  (« L’abus d’**alcool** est dangereux pour la
santé, à consommer avec modération »)

#### About Us

## Balkan Kosher provides Kosher food Consultations

Balkan Kosher is proud to be the leader in strengthening Kosher output in the Balkan region and in
facilitating availability of Balkan Kosher products throughout the world. 

Balkan Kosher provides Kosher food Consultations, Supervisions & Certifications primarily throughout
the Balkans. From our offices in Thessaloniki and Tirana, we are easily available throughout Greece,
Albania, Montenegro and all countries in the Balkan and Mediterranean region. With offices in Israel
and the USA, and agreements with other Kosher organizations, we are able to help facilitate
international commerce. 

We are working with clients and vendors to Kosherize products and services for the benefit of
tourism and local economies. Our clients are:
* Food manufacturers seeking to expand into the international Kosher marketplace.
* Hotels that cater Jewish events and tourists in the Balkan region.
* Consumers that rely upon the high standards of kosher certification for Halal and other dietary
  needs.

Balkan Kosher is a branch of Balkan Jewish Communities, a 501c3 non-profit organization.

## Our Story

With the backing of the Rohr Foundation and Merkos Chabad, and with the encouragement of Rabbi
Shlomo Amar (then Chief Sephardic Rabbi of Israel) and of Rabbi Moshe BenTov, Sephardic Kabbalist;
the Kaplan family arrived in Salonika in 2009.

Their mission was to kindle the revival of the Sephardic-Ladino heritage and to develop Jewish
infrastructure to accommodate the rejuvenation of Jewish life in the Balkans. 

The establishment of Balkan Kosher was one of Rabbi Kaplan’s first projects as a means of developing
this infrastructure.

One of the goals of Balkan Kosher is to support the local economy by opening opportunities for Greek
and Balkan exports to Israel, the USA, to Europe, Asia and more. 

To this end, Rabbi Kaplan is in contact with government agencies and travels the world to provide
business opportunities for companies in the Balkan food industry and to bring much needed kosher
ingredients to Greece and the Balkans.

Today, international cultural and government events are now much easier to host in the Balkans,
because of the availability of kosher food and hospitality made possible through the work of Balkan
Kosher since 2009.

Another obvious goal has been to supply kosher food for the Chabad activities and hospitality in
Thessalonika and throughout the Balkans, as well as for local Balkan Jews and tourists. Previously,
visitors to Thessalonika had great difficulty finding kosher food and accommodations. Those Jews
seeking family and Ladino ties are now able to make the pilgrimage to “La Madre de Israel” with
comfort, ease and fully kosher accommodations (both luxury and budget) at the Thessalonika Chabad
Center and other venues.

We are proud to have been instrumental in the growth of Thessalonika as a prime tourist destination,
with kosher food and hotels available, so that visitors can explore the rich Jewish history and
beautiful Greek countryside and islands.

In addition to kosherizing local Balkan food products throughout the Balkans, many lives are being
touched by the frequent stopovers of Rabbi Yoel Kaplan as he attends to the needs of Jews in cities
scattered throughout the Balkan countryside; as well as by the constant presence of Rabbi Yosef
Kaplan in Thessalonika.

Balkan Kosher is a non-profit branch of Balkan Jewish Communities Charitable organization, dedicated
to providing the infrastructure of Jewish life in the Balkan States and supporting local enterprise.

## Reasons to become Kosher Certified

##### Industrial Sales

A kosher certified ingredient or product could very well make the difference between making or
losing sales to another food processor or importer. Many companies maintain kosher certification
because it makes their product more marketable. Many companies, processors, importers and
distributors throughout Europe, the Balkans and Turkey are kosher certified and will buy only kosher
certified raw materials and products for their own manufacturing and sales.

##### Business Sales

Areas that have strong Jewish/Israeli tourism are also markets for kosher foods. There has been a
steadily growing Israeli tourism industry throughout the Balkan countries especially since Balkan
Kosher has made kosher food more accessible to hotels and for catered events.

##### Retail Sales and Exports

Not only Jewish people seek kosher products. In fact, in Russia and the USA, the majority of kosher
products are consumed by non-Jews. There are many reasons for this, such as the desire for a
certifiable pure product, reliable food allergy content, and vegetarian and vegan verification. For
the large Muslim Halal market, kosher is permitted.

Countries with large Jewish populations have viable kosher markets. These countries are: Israel,
USA, Mexico, Argentina, UK, France, Russia and Australia and more.

The Kosher marketplace is one more aspect of the food market. And in order to compete within that
market, a food processor must obtain the services of a Kosher Food Consultation and Certification
agency.

#### About Us

## Balkan Kosher provides Kosher food Consultations

Balkan Kosher is proud to be the leader in strengthening Kosher output in the Balkan region and in
facilitating availability of Balkan Kosher products throughout the world. 

Balkan Kosher provides Kosher food Consultations, Supervisions & Certifications primarily throughout
the Balkans. From our offices in Thessaloniki and Tirana, we are easily available throughout Greece,
Albania, Montenegro and all countries in the Balkan and Mediterranean region. With offices in Israel
and the USA, and agreements with other Kosher organizations, we are able to help facilitate
international commerce. 

We are working with clients and vendors to Kosherize products and services for the benefit of
tourism and local economies. Our clients are:
* Food manufacturers seeking to expand into the international Kosher marketplace.
* Hotels that cater Jewish events and tourists in the Balkan region.
* Consumers that rely upon the high standards of kosher certification for Halal and other dietary
  needs.

Balkan Kosher is a branch of Balkan Jewish Communities, a 501c3 non-profit organization.

## Reasons to become Kosher Certified

##### Industrial Sales

A kosher certified ingredient or product could very well make the difference between making or
losing sales to another food processor or importer. Many companies maintain kosher certification
because it makes their product more marketable. Many companies, processors, importers and
distributors throughout Europe, the Balkans and Turkey are kosher certified and will buy only kosher
certified raw materials and products for their own manufacturing and sales.

##### Business Sales

Areas that have strong Jewish/Israeli tourism are also markets for kosher foods. There has been a
steadily growing Israeli tourism industry throughout the Balkan countries especially since Balkan
Kosher has made kosher food more accessible to hotels and for catered events.

##### Retail Sales and Exports

Not only Jewish people seek kosher products. In fact, in Russia and the USA, the majority of kosher
products are consumed by non-Jews. There are many reasons for this, such as the desire for a
certifiable pure product, reliable food allergy content, and vegetarian and vegan verification. For
the large Muslim Halal market, kosher is permitted.

Countries with large Jewish populations have viable kosher markets. These countries are: Israel,
USA, Mexico, Argentina, UK, France, Russia and Australia and more.

The Kosher marketplace is one more aspect of the food market. And in order to compete within that
market, a food processor must obtain the services of a Kosher Food Consultation and Certification
agency.

processes, and procedures are thoroughly evaluated against the relevant ISO standards. These
standards ensure that a company adheres to best practices, promotes continual improvement, and
complies with legal and regulatory requirements.

trustworthiness, instilling confidence in clients and stakeholders. The certification can open doors
to new business opportunities, as many clients prefer or require their partners to hold ISO
certification. Moreover, ISO-certified businesses often experience improved operational efficiency
and reduced waste.

standards to ensure the quality, safety, and efficiency of products, services, and systems. ISO
standards covers a large boundary of industries and are recognised worldwide for their relevance and
results.

family-owned company based in Baton Rouge, LA, with offices in San Francisco, Atlanta, Chicago,
Wisconsin, and New York. Despite our growth, we are still able to offer personalized services to our
clients, which we believe are unrivaled in the industry.

# Domestic Sugar Distribution

Champion Foods is an experienced distributor of Mexican sugar in the United States, and is able to
work across the spectrum, including large industrial companies, food service distributors and small
grocery stores, to provide our clients with a variety of price, quantity, quality, and packaging
options for our Mexican sugar.

# International Sugar Exportation

Champion Foods is an exporter of Brazilian sugar worldwide.  We export ICUMSA 45, ICUMSA 150, and
ICUMSA 600-1200 Brazilian sugar to virtually anywhere in the world.  Our Brazilian sugar is the best
quality at competitive prices.  We’re proud to partner with industry-leading sugar providers in
Brazil, which allows us to source Brazilian sugar for our clients.  We export to India, China, the
European Union, and many other locations across the globe.

fruits** and **nuts**, offering a wide variety of **gourmet products** for food professionals. Based
in the heart of Marseille, our family-owned company is committed to providing only the highest

preservatives. This dedication to quality allows us to maintain the authentic taste and nutritional
value of our products, catering to the specific needs of each customer.

Our product range includes **almonds**, **cashews**, **hazelnuts**, **pistachios**, and various
other carefully selected dried fruits and **seeds** such as sunflower and pumpkin seeds. We offer
these products in a variety of options: **salted**, **unsalted**, and with **spices**, depending on
our customers' preferences. To meet the needs of different markets, we also provide bulk options, as
well as 250g, 500g, or pallet-size packaging, adaptable for **retailers**, **restaurants**,
**hotels**, **bakery suppliers**, and food manufacturing industries.

## What packaging options are available at CROC'ELLA for food professionals?

At **CROC'ELLA**, we offer tailored packaging solutions for all types of food professionals, whether
in bulk, sachets, or pallet-sized deliveries. Additionally, private label packaging is available for
clients meeting minimum order requirements. We take pride in flexibility to ensure our clients
receive the perfect packaging for their specific needs.

All our roasted dried fruits are **Kosher-certified** and we also carry an organic range. As an
artisanal producer in the south of France, **CROC'ELLA** is dedicated to meeting the highest
standards of quality, ensuring every batch is fresh and made in France. Whether you’re a wholesaler,
a restaurant owner, or a bakery supplier, contact us today to learn how we can supply you with

## Manufacturer and Wholesaler of Roasted Dried Fruits in Marseille - At **CROC'ELLA**

At **CROC'ELLA**, we specialize in the **manufacture** and **wholesale** of premium **roasted dried
fruits** and **nuts**, offering a wide variety of **gourmet products** for food professionals. Based
in the heart of Marseille, our family-owned company is committed to providing only the highest
quality products, freshly roasted to perfection without any oils, flavors, additives, or
preservatives. This dedication to quality allows us to maintain the authentic taste and nutritional
value of our products, catering to the specific needs of each customer.

Our product range includes **almonds**, **cashews**, **hazelnuts**, **pistachios**, and various
other carefully selected dried fruits and **seeds** such as sunflower and pumpkin seeds. We offer
these products in a variety of options: **salted**, **unsalted**, and with **spices**, depending on
our customers' preferences. To meet the needs of different markets, we also provide bulk options, as
well as 250g, 500g, or pallet-size packaging, adaptable for **retailers**, **restaurants**,
**hotels**, **bakery suppliers**, and food manufacturing industries.

## What packaging options are available at CROC'ELLA for food professionals?

At **CROC'ELLA**, we offer tailored packaging solutions for all types of food professionals, whether
in bulk, sachets, or pallet-sized deliveries. Additionally, private label packaging is available for
clients meeting minimum order requirements. We take pride in flexibility to ensure our clients
receive the perfect packaging for their specific needs.

All our roasted dried fruits are **Kosher-certified** and we also carry an organic range. As an
artisanal producer in the south of France, **CROC'ELLA** is dedicated to meeting the highest
standards of quality, ensuring every batch is fresh and made in France. Whether you’re a wholesaler,
a restaurant owner, or a bakery supplier, contact us today to learn how we can supply you with
superior roasted dried fruits.

# Specialists in Kosher Foods.

Drumstick Products Co is a family owned business and has been trading since 1967; it is now one of
the largest kosher food distributors to the UK market and beyond. We distribute many kosher food
brands sourced from Israel, Europe, the USA and Asia.

[Shop all Products][50] [Contact Us][51]

### About Us

Drumsticks Products Co. started in a small basement as manufacturers of pretzel sticks which were
produced with an automatic machine purchased in Europe for manufacturing & packing these
‘’Drumsticks’’. We slowly started importing other products e.g. biscuits, grocery, etc. to add to
our product list.

In 1973 due to a fire we had to stop manufacturing. As we reopened, we added more lines to our range
and expanded to include confectionary.

# Specialists in Kosher Foods.

Drumstick Products Co is a family owned business and has been trading since 1967; it is now one of
the largest kosher food distributors to the UK market and beyond. We distribute many kosher food
brands sourced from Israel, Europe, the USA and Asia.

[Shop all Products][50] [Contact Us][51]
[supermarket-image-2]

#### Shop by Brand

[View all Brands][52]
[Pretzel Image]

### About Us

Drumsticks Products Co. started in a small basement as manufacturers of pretzel sticks which were
produced with an automatic machine purchased in Europe for manufacturing & packing these
‘’Drumsticks’’. We slowly started importing other products e.g. biscuits, grocery, etc. to add to
our product list.

In 1973 due to a fire we had to stop manufacturing. As we reopened, we added more lines to our range
and expanded to include confectionary.

* Objectif plein emploi
* Services publics
* Planification écologique
* L'Europe

[

### Un État qui protège

Une France forte, libre de ses actes, capable de veiller sur ses citoyens et d’assumer son
rayonnement mondial.

][71]
[big file image]
[

### Objectif plein emploi

La France tient son rang de grande puissance économique, la 7e au monde et la 2e en Europe.

][72]
[big file image]
[

### Services publics

Fidèle à sa devise, la France travaille à bâtir une société plus juste, qui donne à chacun les
moyens de s’épanouir et ne laisse personne de côté.

][73]
[big file image]
[

### Planification écologique

Depuis son élection, en France comme sur la scène internationale, la cause écologique est l’une des
priorités du Président de la République.

][74]
[big file image]
[

### L'Europe

Sept ans après le premier discours de la Sorbonne pour une Europe souveraine, unie et démocratique.

][75]
[big file image]
[links module image]

### La Maison Élysée

La Maison Élysée est située en face du Palais de l’Élysée et permet aux visiteurs de découvrir
l'histoire et le patrimoine de l'Élysée toute l’année.

][80]
[big file image]
[

### Visite virtuelle

Découvrez le Palais de l'Elysée. Une exploration interactive, ludique et à 360° de ce lieu
historique.

][81]

  Découvrez l'histoire des résidences présidentielles.

  Découvrez nos produits fabriqués en France et soutenez les projets de restauration de l'Elysée

## How FSSC benefits your organization

The Foundation FSSC provides oversight, transparency, and industry involvement to ensure our Schemes
remain relevant and credible within the consumer goods industry.

[ All benefits][94]

#### Non-Profit


Foundation FSSC is a not-for-profit organization with an independent governance structure. Giving
back is key to FSSC’s strategy. As part of our giving back strategy, we support UN capacity-building
activities.

[Read more][95]

#### Providing trust


Our Schemes are governed by an independent Board of Stakeholders. Through the FSSC Integrity Program
we monitor compliance of our licensed Certification Bodies, to ensure a robust and trusted
certification process.

[Read more][96]

#### Risk-based approach


Our Schemes are aligned with the ISO management system approach that allows for flexibility in
implementation, based on a risk-based approach.

[Read more][97]

#### Supporting SMEs


We support small and medium-sized organizations (SMEs) through a process of knowledge-sharing and
other tools to further build an understanding of food safety and social sustainability. One of our
tools is the FSSC 22000 Development Program.

[Read more][98]

#### GFSI and SSCI recognition


Our FSSC 22000 Scheme holds the Consumer Goods Forum’s (CGF) Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI)
recognition, and is IAF-approved. The FSSC 24000 Scheme for social management systems is recognized
by the CGF’s Social Supply Chain Initiative (SSCI), endorsed as an IAF MLA sub-scope, and part of
the ITC Standards Map. All recognitions confirm industry acceptance and technical rigor. 

[Read more][99]

#### Contributing to SDGs


As a UN Global Compact member, we aim to actively contribute to the Sustainable Development Goals.

[Read more][100]

## FSSC Integrity Program

FSSC provides trust through its multi-stakeholder governance, partnering with recognized
Accreditation Bodies and the deployment of its Integrity Program, assuring the acceptable
performance of licensed Certification Bodies.

The FSSC Integrity Program ensures Certification Body compliance with Scheme requirements through
assessment activities and performance measurement resulting in trusted certification.

[Learn more][116]

#### Take your first step toward food safety certification

## FSSC Development Program

Small and medium-sized organizations (SMEs) play a significant role in the food supply chain. To
support these organizations in the supply of safe food, we offer the [FSSC Development
Program][117]. The FSSC Development Program is aligned with CODEX HACCP, GFSI Global Markets, and
fits into the FSSC 22000 structure. From a procurement perspective, it serves as a tool to assure
food safety in your supply base.

## How FSSC benefits your organization

The Foundation FSSC provides oversight, transparency, and industry involvement to ensure our Schemes
remain relevant and credible within the consumer goods industry.

[ All benefits][94]

#### Non-Profit


Foundation FSSC is a not-for-profit organization with an independent governance structure. Giving
back is key to FSSC’s strategy. As part of our giving back strategy, we support UN capacity-building
activities.

[Read more][95]

#### Providing trust


Our Schemes are governed by an independent Board of Stakeholders. Through the FSSC Integrity Program
we monitor compliance of our licensed Certification Bodies, to ensure a robust and trusted
certification process.

[Read more][96]

#### Risk-based approach


Our Schemes are aligned with the ISO management system approach that allows for flexibility in
implementation, based on a risk-based approach.

[Read more][97]

#### Supporting SMEs


We support small and medium-sized organizations (SMEs) through a process of knowledge-sharing and
other tools to further build an understanding of food safety and social sustainability. One of our
tools is the FSSC 22000 Development Program.

[Read more][98]

#### GFSI and SSCI recognition


Our FSSC 22000 Scheme holds the Consumer Goods Forum’s (CGF) Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI)
recognition, and is IAF-approved. The FSSC 24000 Scheme for social management systems is recognized
by the CGF’s Social Supply Chain Initiative (SSCI), endorsed as an IAF MLA sub-scope, and part of
the ITC Standards Map. All recognitions confirm industry acceptance and technical rigor. 

[Read more][99]

#### Contributing to SDGs


As a UN Global Compact member, we aim to actively contribute to the Sustainable Development Goals.

[Read more][100]

## FSSC Integrity Program

FSSC provides trust through its multi-stakeholder governance, partnering with recognized
Accreditation Bodies and the deployment of its Integrity Program, assuring the acceptable
performance of licensed Certification Bodies.

The FSSC Integrity Program ensures Certification Body compliance with Scheme requirements through
assessment activities and performance measurement resulting in trusted certification.

[Learn more][116]

#### Take your first step toward food safety certification

## FSSC Development Program

Small and medium-sized organizations (SMEs) play a significant role in the food supply chain. To
support these organizations in the supply of safe food, we offer the [FSSC Development
Program][117]. The FSSC Development Program is aligned with CODEX HACCP, GFSI Global Markets, and
fits into the FSSC 22000 structure. From a procurement perspective, it serves as a tool to assure
food safety in your supply base.

# Judaism 101

Answering **F**requently **A**sked **Q**uestions about Jews and Judaism in plain English for a
quarter of a century

Judaism 101 or "Jew FAQ" is an online encyclopedia of Judaism, covering Jewish beliefs, people,
places, things, language, scripture, holidays, practices and customs, written from a traditional
perspective in conversational language you can understand.

[[Tisha B'Av]Tisha B'Avsunset July 22, 2026 - nightfall July 23, 2026
The 9th of Av is a major fast day commemorating the many tragedies that have befallen the Jewish
people, several of which occurred on this date.][13]
[ Hebrew Alphabet See illustrations of the letters and vowel points of the Hebrew alphabet in print,
script and Rashi script. Learn the names and numerical values of the letters. Also discusses
transliteration (writing Hebrew in English letters). ][14] [ Current Calendar
See the current Hebrew month and the upcoming two months with links to upcoming holidays and Torah
readings. ][15] [ [Jewish Star] What Do Jews Believe? Reviewing the 13 Principles of Faith that are
widely-accepted as the core of Jewish belief. ][16] [ 613 Mitzvot (Commandments)
Judaism does not have 10 Commandments. It has 613 commandments that affect every aspect of our
lives, the perfect religion for the obsessive-compulsive! This is a list of the 613 commandments
based on the list by the medieval scholar Rambam (Maimonides). ][17] [ What is Judaism?
Is it a religion? A race? An ethnic/cultural group? Or something more? ][18] [
Ashkenazic and Sephardic Jews
Ashkenazic and Sephardic are cultural subgroups of Judaism. Learn about the differences between
Sephardic (Spanish/Middle Eastern) and Ashkenazic (German/Eastern European), and other cultural
subgroups. ][19] [ Jewish Calendar
Learn about the Jewish calendar, its background and history, the numbering of Jewish years, the
months of the Jewish year and the days of the Jewish week. ][20] [ Rabbis, Priests, and Other
Religious Functionaries
A rabbi is not a Jewish priest. Learn about the role of rabbis, chazzans (cantors), gabbais, kohanim
(priests), Levites, rebbes and tzaddiks in Jewish life. ][21] [ Shema
The Shema is the oldest fixed daily prayer in Judaism, recited morning and night since ancient
times. See the full text in Hebrew, English and transliterated Hebrew. ][22]

[What's Nu?][23] | [Current Calendar][24] | [About][25]

# J&M

## Distrib

La société J&M distrib affiliée à BRM-MARKETING, est chargée d'importer des produits israéliens
ainsi que d'exporter des produits kosher européens. La distribution de nos produits en France est
opérée à l'aide de partenaires, tandis que nous assurons le bon déroulement de l'approvisionnement
depuis la production jusqu'au service après-vente. Tous nos produits sont certifiés "kosher", marqué
du tampon du Rabbinat d'Israël et/ou de Paris assurant aux consommateurs une garantie de qualité et
de respect de lois religieuses. Nous exportons et importons un vaste panel de produits frais,
surgelés, épicerie, condiments et boissons.

différents rabinats de France, d'Angleterre, des Etats-unis et d'Israel. Nous désirons toujours
élargir nos horizons afin de proposer un choix toujours plus grand et varié de produits
agro-alimentaires.

# J&M

## Distrib

La société J&M distrib affiliée à BRM-MARKETING, est chargée d'importer des produits israéliens
ainsi que d'exporter des produits kosher européens. La distribution de nos produits en France est
opérée à l'aide de partenaires, tandis que nous assurons le bon déroulement de l'approvisionnement
depuis la production jusqu'au service après-vente. Tous nos produits sont certifiés "kosher", marqué
du tampon du Rabbinat d'Israël et/ou de Paris assurant aux consommateurs une garantie de qualité et
de respect de lois religieuses. Nous exportons et importons un vaste panel de produits frais,
surgelés, épicerie, condiments et boissons.

## Nos partenaires

Nos partenaires distribuent nos produits, en France et en Israel.

différents rabinats de France, d'Angleterre, des Etats-unis et d'Israel. Nous désirons toujours
élargir nos horizons afin de proposer un choix toujours plus grand et varié de produits
agro-alimentaires.

# Ensuring Excellence in Kosher Certification

Based in Philadelphia and backed by over a century of expertise, Ko Kosher Service provides trusted
kosher supervision worldwide for the food, pharmaceutical, and chemical industries, blending
tradition with personalized attention.

[Learn More][9]

## Tailored Kosher Certification Across All Sectors

Ko Kosher Service proudly brings over a century of expertise in providing trusted kosher
certification globally. Based in Philadelphia, we blend tradition with strict standards to serve the
food, pharmaceutical, and chemical industries, ensuring compliance with integrity, fairness, and
personalized attention.

## Trusted Kosher Certification Worldwide

Explore our comprehensive kosher certification services, dedicated to quality, fairness, and
personalized care.

### Kosher Food Certification

Ensure your food products meet the highest kosher standards with our expert guidance.

### Pharmaceutical Kosher Supervision

We provide precise kosher compliance solutions for pharmaceuticals and health products.

### Chemical Industry Certification

Reliable kosher certification tailored for chemicals, guaranteeing full compliance and safety.

personalized service.

## About Us

### Kosher Check is a non-profit global kosher certification agency.

With Regional offices located throughout Asia, Europe, and North America. We currently serve
hundreds of food manufacturers throughout Canada, the US, the Pacific Rim, and the Far East, through
our extensive network of regional rabbinic representatives around the globe. For over 30 years,
Kosher Check (formerly known as BC Kosher) has been widely recognized as an accepted Orthodox kosher
certification agency. Under the leadership of the British Columbia Beth Din, directed by Rabbi
Avraham Feigelstock, Kosher Check provides certification for industry leaders including Kerry Foods,
Bakemark Canada (CSM), Golden Boy Foods, Garden Protein and Canadian Fishing Company. In Asia, some
of our industry leading clients include Layn Natural Ingredients, Kemin Bioscience and Profood
International.

## About Us

### Kosher Check is a non-profit global kosher certification agency.

With Regional offices located throughout Asia, Europe, and North America. We currently serve
hundreds of food manufacturers throughout Canada, the US, the Pacific Rim, and the Far East, through
our extensive network of regional rabbinic representatives around the globe. For over 30 years,
Kosher Check (formerly known as BC Kosher) has been widely recognized as an accepted Orthodox kosher
certification agency. Under the leadership of the British Columbia Beth Din, directed by Rabbi
Avraham Feigelstock, Kosher Check provides certification for industry leaders including Kerry Foods,
Bakemark Canada (CSM), Golden Boy Foods, Garden Protein and Canadian Fishing Company. In Asia, some
of our industry leading clients include Layn Natural Ingredients, Kemin Bioscience and Profood
International.

With the Kosher Check symbol you can rest assured that your products will be marketable, recognized,
and widely accepted. Just as importantly, Kosher Check is proud of the relationships we have
developed and nurtured with our clients. It is with our excellent customer service, as well as our
reasonable fee structure, that we have created such a solid reputation in this industry. Studies
have confirmed a direct correlation between the Kosher Check symbol and increased sales. Become
Kosher Check certified and discover the “Kosher Check Difference”.

#### Approval

We will send you an agreement with the terms of your Kosher program. Congratulations! You’re

agencies in the world.

# من أهم الشركات المانحة لشهادات الأيزو والجودة فى مصر و الشرق الاوسط بجانب دول أفريقيا. وقد بدأت
# الشركة نشاطها منذ عام 2011
* منح شهادات الايزو في مختلف المجالات (ISO Certification)
* خدمات الفحص والمعايرات الهندسية للاوناش (Inspection -Calibration)
* التسجيل لدى هيئة الغذاء والدواء الامريكية (FDA Registeration)
* تدريب الافراد علي نظم الجودة
* منح شهادات الحلال
* منح شهادات BRC

## أحدث الأخبار

حصل المتحف المصري الكبير بالقاهرة على شهادات نظم الإدارة الدولية ISO 9001 لإدارة الجودة، وISO 14001
للإدارة البيئية، وISO 45001 للسلامة والصحة المهنية، وذلك عقب اجتيازه أعمال المراجعة والتقييم ومنح
الشهادات من خلال شركة OSS Middle East.
في إطار دعمها المستمر للتميز المؤسسي وتطبيق المعايير الدولية، حصلت مؤسسة مجدي يعقوب على شهادة ISO
21001 الخاصة بنظم إدارة المؤسسات التعليمية، وذلك بعد استكمال أعمال المراجعة والتقييم ومنح الشهادة من
خلال شركة OSS Middle East.
حصلت شركة مصر للطيران للشحن الجوي على شهادات نظم الإدارة الدولية ISO 9001 لنظام إدارة الجودة وISO
14001 لنظام الإدارة البيئية وISO 45001 لنظام إدارة السلامة والصحة المهنية، وذلك عقب اجتيازها بنجاح
أعمال المراجعة والتقييم التي تمت من خلال شركة OSS Middle East.
نادي الاتحاد السعودي يحصل علي شهاده ايزو ٢٠١٢١ الخاص باداره الفاعليات وقد قامت شركه oss middle east
باجراءات المراجعه ومنح الشهاده وفقا لالتزام اداره النادي باتباع بندود المواصفه

# من أهم الشركات المانحة لشهادات الأيزو والجودة فى مصر و الشرق الاوسط بجانب دول أفريقيا. وقد بدأت
# الشركة نشاطها منذ عام 2011
* منح شهادات الايزو في مختلف المجالات (ISO Certification)
* خدمات الفحص والمعايرات الهندسية للاوناش (Inspection -Calibration)
* التسجيل لدى هيئة الغذاء والدواء الامريكية (FDA Registeration)
* تدريب الافراد علي نظم الجودة
* منح شهادات الحلال
* منح شهادات BRC

## أحدث الأخبار

حصل المتحف المصري الكبير بالقاهرة على شهادات نظم الإدارة الدولية ISO 9001 لإدارة الجودة، وISO 14001
للإدارة البيئية، وISO 45001 للسلامة والصحة المهنية، وذلك عقب اجتيازه أعمال المراجعة والتقييم ومنح
الشهادات من خلال شركة OSS Middle East.
في إطار دعمها المستمر للتميز المؤسسي وتطبيق المعايير الدولية، حصلت مؤسسة مجدي يعقوب على شهادة ISO
21001 الخاصة بنظم إدارة المؤسسات التعليمية، وذلك بعد استكمال أعمال المراجعة والتقييم ومنح الشهادة من
خلال شركة OSS Middle East.
حصلت شركة مصر للطيران للشحن الجوي على شهادات نظم الإدارة الدولية ISO 9001 لنظام إدارة الجودة وISO
14001 لنظام الإدارة البيئية وISO 45001 لنظام إدارة السلامة والصحة المهنية، وذلك عقب اجتيازها بنجاح
أعمال المراجعة والتقييم التي تمت من خلال شركة OSS Middle East.
نادي الاتحاد السعودي يحصل علي شهاده ايزو ٢٠١٢١ الخاص باداره الفاعليات وقد قامت شركه oss middle east
باجراءات المراجعه ومنح الشهاده وفقا لالتزام اداره النادي باتباع بندود المواصفه

## **Why Choose the OU**

**Reach more consumers worldwide**
For 100 years the OU symbol has been the most recognized kosher mark.  Its promoted through our
global programs, social media, apps, and websites.

**Get help navigating the supply chain**
Access manufacturers worldwide through the largest kosher ingredients database and get help finding
approved ingredients and co-packers

**Build trust with retailers and brands**
Major retailers and global food companies rely on the OU symbol, backed by our detailed review of
ingredients, processes, and labels.

[More on Why the OU][174]

## **What is Kosher?**

You may already be familiar with some of the more well-known requirements, but you may be surprised
at the extent of some regulations. Kosher is a comprehensive system of food standards rooted in
Jewish law that governs not only ingredients, but also how food is prepared, processed, and handled.

Under trusted certification such as OU Kosher, every step of production is carefully reviewed, from
raw materials to equipment and facilities. This level of oversight helps ensure consistency,
integrity, and trust, giving consumers greater confidence in the products they choose.

## **Why Choose the OU**

**Reach more consumers worldwide**
For 100 years the OU symbol has been the most recognized kosher mark.  Its promoted through our
global programs, social media, apps, and websites.

**Get help navigating the supply chain**
Access manufacturers worldwide through the largest kosher ingredients database and get help finding
approved ingredients and co-packers

**Build trust with retailers and brands**
Major retailers and global food companies rely on the OU symbol, backed by our detailed review of
ingredients, processes, and labels.

[More on Why the OU][174]

## **What is Kosher?**

You may already be familiar with some of the more well-known requirements, but you may be surprised
at the extent of some regulations. Kosher is a comprehensive system of food standards rooted in
Jewish law that governs not only ingredients, but also how food is prepared, processed, and handled.

Under trusted certification such as OU Kosher, every step of production is carefully reviewed, from
raw materials to equipment and facilities. This level of oversight helps ensure consistency,
integrity, and trust, giving consumers greater confidence in the products they choose.

## WHO ARE THE BUYERS AND SUPPLIERS ON UFOODIN ?

## Suppliers

Raw Material Suppliers

– Agricultural producers (farmers) providing raw food products like fruits, vegetables, grains, and
dairy.

– Ingredient suppliers offering spices, flavors, additives, and other components.

Food and Beverage Manufacturers

Companies producing packaged food and beverages for distribution and sale.

Packaging Material Suppliers

Manufacturers and distributors of packaging materials, including labels, and packaging solutions.

Equipment Providers

Manufacturers and suppliers of food processing machinery, kitchen equipment, and packaging
machinery.

Commodity Traders

Traders dealing with commodities like grains, spices, oils, and other raw materials.

Wholesalers and Distributors

Wholesalers selling products to supply to retailers or other businesses in the food and beverage
sector.

## Buyers

Food and Beverage Manufacturers

Companies sourcing raw materials and ingredients for the production of packaged food and beverages.

Restaurants, Hotels and Catering Services

Businesses in the foodservice industry looking for bulk ingredients, finished products, equipment,
and supplies for their operations.

Wholesalers and Distributors

Distributors sourcing products to supply to retailers or other businesses in the food and beverage
sector.

Retailers and Grocery Chains

Supermarkets, grocery stores, and other retail chains seeking a variety of products for their
shelves.

Importers and Exporters

Businesses involved in the import and export of food and beverage products, ingredients, and
commodities.

Food Service Equipment Buyers

Companies looking to purchase kitchen equipment, machinery, and other related items for their
foodservice operations.

Packaging Material Buyers

Businesses in need of packaging solutions, including containers, labels, and other packaging
materials.

# Vaad Kosher Symbols, Kosher Supervision, Hechshers & List of Vaads

Vaad information for the United States and all around the world. A Vaad provides Kosher
certification wherever you are!

We help connect companies that are looking for kosher supervision with Vaads from around the world.
Having a Kosher symbol on your label opens up your product up to an entire new market.

The Hebrew meaning of Vaad is committee. It is often used nowadays as a short form of Vaad ha
Rabanim which means council of Rabbis. In Israel, prior to independence (from 1920 – 1948), the Vaad
Leumi or the JNC (Jewish National Council) was the primary governing body.

To see a list of Vaads and kosher symbols from around the world, please visit the [list of
Vaads][16] section.

If you know of a Vaad that is not listed, please [let us know][17]!

In general, vaads are committees composed of prominent members of the community who help set
standards and rules. They often include Rabbis and laymen. They usually address issues such as
Kosher standards and certification (vaad haKashruth), legal issues (Bet Din), proper burial (Chevra
Kadisha), educational services, etc.

The highest council guiding the Jewish communities of Eastern Europe, from 1580 to 1764 was the
Council of the Four Lands (Vaad Arba Aaratzot). They included the regions of Western & Central
Poland, Eastern Poland, Ruthenia and the Western Ukraine. The Vaad was basically divided into
subgroups, the religious and judicial arm, that was headed by Rabbis, and the administrative arm,
headed by community leaders, that dealt with charity and interfacing with the country’s government.
This was especially important in the matter of taxation.

In the land of Israel, from 1920 until 1948, [the Vaad Leumi][18] was responsible for interfacing
with the British and Arabs. It also had educational, health, welfare, and communal rolls.
Eventually, due to external threats to Jewish survival, it also became involved with defense and
security.

Presently, there are over one thousand Vaads, across the globe. They are usually associated with
geographical locations, such as cities, states or countries. As a rule of thumb, the greater the
Jewish population, the greater the number of Vaads. Very often, these Vaads are involved with
certifying foods as Kosher. They send individuals, known as Mashgiachs, to establishments that serve
or manufacture food, to make sure that the food is prepared in accordance with Kosher laws. The
various branches of Judaism (such as Orthodox or Conservative) often have their own Vaads. Each of
these Vaads have their Kosher symbols.

strict religious standards. The process involves thorough inspections and ongoing supervision to
maintain the integrity of kosher foods. Read on to better understand the significance of a Vaad and

respected rabbis and community leaders, are responsible for overseeing the adherence to kosher laws
within their jurisdiction. Their duties include:
1. **Certification and Supervision:** Vaads issue kosher certifications, known as hechshers, to food
   manufacturers, restaurants, and catering services that meet the required standards. This
   certification is not a one-time event but an ongoing process involving regular inspections and
   surprise visits to ensure compliance.

### Understanding Kosher Certification: A Deeper Dive into Vaads and Hechshers

Kosher certification is an essential aspect of Jewish dietary laws, ensuring that food products meet
strict religious standards. The process involves thorough inspections and ongoing supervision to
maintain the integrity of kosher foods. Read on to better understand the significance of a Vaad and
the importance of kosher symbols in the global market.

### How Does a Vaad Provide Kosher Certification

Vaads play a crucial role in the kosher certification process. These committees, often comprising
respected rabbis and community leaders, are responsible for overseeing the adherence to kosher laws
within their jurisdiction. Their duties include:
1. **Certification and Supervision:** Vaads issue kosher certifications, known as hechshers, to food
   manufacturers, restaurants, and catering services that meet the required standards. This
   certification is not a one-time event but an ongoing process involving regular inspections and
   surprise visits to ensure compliance.
2. **Educational Outreach:** Vaads educate both the Jewish community and food producers about kosher
   laws. They provide resources and training to help businesses understand and implement kosher
   practices effectively.
3. **Community Support:** Beyond food certification, Vaads often engage in various community
   services such as providing educational programs, legal assistance through Bet Din (Jewish
   courts), and support for religious and cultural activities.

### Kosher Symbols

Kosher symbols, or hechshers signify trust and quality. For observant Jews, these symbols ensure
that the food they consume adheres to their dietary laws. However, the appeal of kosher
certification extends beyond the Jewish community.
1. **Market Expansion:** Products with kosher certification tap into a broader market, including
   consumers who perceive kosher foods as cleaner and healthier due to the rigorous standards they
   meet. This includes people with dietary restrictions, such as lactose intolerance or gluten
   sensitivity, as kosher foods often clearly label their ingredients.
2. **Global Recognition:** Kosher symbols are recognized worldwide, offering a significant advantage
   for companies looking to expand their reach. The presence of a reliable kosher certification can
   boost a product’s appeal in international markets.

### The Historical Significance of Vaads

The history of Vaads is deeply rooted in Jewish tradition and community governance. The Council of
the Four Lands, mentioned earlier, exemplifies the pivotal role these committees played in Jewish
life. This council was instrumental in managing communal affairs, negotiating with governments, and
ensuring the welfare of Jewish communities across vast regions.

Similarly, the Vaad Leumi during the British Mandate in Palestine showcased the adaptability of
Vaads in addressing contemporary issues while staying true to Jewish values. Their involvement in
defense and security during tumultuous times highlights their critical role in community resilience
and survival.

### Modern-Day Vaads: Global Presence and Impact

Today, Vaads are present in nearly every country with a significant Jewish population. From the
bustling cities of the United States to the remote communities in South America and Asia, Vaads
ensure that kosher standards are upheld worldwide.
1. **Regional Adaptations:** Vaads adapt their practices to fit the unique challenges and needs of
   their regions. This might involve dealing with different food production methods, agricultural
   products, or cultural practices while maintaining the core principles of kosher certification.
2. **Technological Integration:** Modern Vaads leverage technology to streamline certification
   processes, maintain databases of certified products, and facilitate better communication between
   inspectors and businesses. This integration helps ensure transparency and efficiency in
   maintaining kosher standards.

### Why Businesses Should Choose Kosher?

For businesses, obtaining kosher certification can be a strategic decision with numerous benefits:
1. **Consumer Trust:** Hechshers build trust among consumers, assuring them of the product’s
   adherence to high standards of quality and religious compliance.
2. **Competitive Edge:** In a crowded market, kosher certification can distinguish products, making
   them more attractive to both Jewish and non-Jewish consumers.
3. **Ethical Assurance:** The ethical implications of kosher laws, such as humane treatment of
   animals and rigorous cleanliness standards, appeal to a growing demographic of ethically
   conscious consumers.

# Vaad Kosher Symbols, Kosher Supervision, Hechshers & List of Vaads

Vaad information for the United States and all around the world. A Vaad provides Kosher
certification wherever you are!

We help connect companies that are looking for kosher supervision with Vaads from around the world.
Having a Kosher symbol on your label opens up your product up to an entire new market.

The Hebrew meaning of Vaad is committee. It is often used nowadays as a short form of Vaad ha
Rabanim which means council of Rabbis. In Israel, prior to independence (from 1920 – 1948), the Vaad
Leumi or the JNC (Jewish National Council) was the primary governing body.

To see a list of Vaads and kosher symbols from around the world, please visit the [list of
Vaads][16] section.

If you know of a Vaad that is not listed, please [let us know][17]!

In general, vaads are committees composed of prominent members of the community who help set
standards and rules. They often include Rabbis and laymen. They usually address issues such as
Kosher standards and certification (vaad haKashruth), legal issues (Bet Din), proper burial (Chevra
Kadisha), educational services, etc.

The highest council guiding the Jewish communities of Eastern Europe, from 1580 to 1764 was the
Council of the Four Lands (Vaad Arba Aaratzot). They included the regions of Western & Central
Poland, Eastern Poland, Ruthenia and the Western Ukraine. The Vaad was basically divided into
subgroups, the religious and judicial arm, that was headed by Rabbis, and the administrative arm,
headed by community leaders, that dealt with charity and interfacing with the country’s government.
This was especially important in the matter of taxation.

In the land of Israel, from 1920 until 1948, [the Vaad Leumi][18] was responsible for interfacing
with the British and Arabs. It also had educational, health, welfare, and communal rolls.
Eventually, due to external threats to Jewish survival, it also became involved with defense and
security.

Presently, there are over one thousand Vaads, across the globe. They are usually associated with
geographical locations, such as cities, states or countries. As a rule of thumb, the greater the
Jewish population, the greater the number of Vaads. Very often, these Vaads are involved with
certifying foods as Kosher. They send individuals, known as Mashgiachs, to establishments that serve
or manufacture food, to make sure that the food is prepared in accordance with Kosher laws. The
various branches of Judaism (such as Orthodox or Conservative) often have their own Vaads. Each of
these Vaads have their Kosher symbols.

### Understanding Kosher Certification: A Deeper Dive into Vaads and Hechshers

Kosher certification is an essential aspect of Jewish dietary laws, ensuring that food products meet
strict religious standards. The process involves thorough inspections and ongoing supervision to
maintain the integrity of kosher foods. Read on to better understand the significance of a Vaad and
the importance of kosher symbols in the global market.

### How Does a Vaad Provide Kosher Certification

Vaads play a crucial role in the kosher certification process. These committees, often comprising
respected rabbis and community leaders, are responsible for overseeing the adherence to kosher laws
within their jurisdiction. Their duties include:
1. **Certification and Supervision:** Vaads issue kosher certifications, known as hechshers, to food
   manufacturers, restaurants, and catering services that meet the required standards. This
   certification is not a one-time event but an ongoing process involving regular inspections and
   surprise visits to ensure compliance.
2. **Educational Outreach:** Vaads educate both the Jewish community and food producers about kosher
   laws. They provide resources and training to help businesses understand and implement kosher
   practices effectively.
3. **Community Support:** Beyond food certification, Vaads often engage in various community
   services such as providing educational programs, legal assistance through Bet Din (Jewish
   courts), and support for religious and cultural activities.

### Kosher Symbols

Kosher symbols, or hechshers signify trust and quality. For observant Jews, these symbols ensure
that the food they consume adheres to their dietary laws. However, the appeal of kosher
certification extends beyond the Jewish community.
1. **Market Expansion:** Products with kosher certification tap into a broader market, including
   consumers who perceive kosher foods as cleaner and healthier due to the rigorous standards they
   meet. This includes people with dietary restrictions, such as lactose intolerance or gluten
   sensitivity, as kosher foods often clearly label their ingredients.
2. **Global Recognition:** Kosher symbols are recognized worldwide, offering a significant advantage
   for companies looking to expand their reach. The presence of a reliable kosher certification can
   boost a product’s appeal in international markets.

### The Historical Significance of Vaads

The history of Vaads is deeply rooted in Jewish tradition and community governance. The Council of
the Four Lands, mentioned earlier, exemplifies the pivotal role these committees played in Jewish
life. This council was instrumental in managing communal affairs, negotiating with governments, and
ensuring the welfare of Jewish communities across vast regions.

Similarly, the Vaad Leumi during the British Mandate in Palestine showcased the adaptability of
Vaads in addressing contemporary issues while staying true to Jewish values. Their involvement in
defense and security during tumultuous times highlights their critical role in community resilience
and survival.

### Modern-Day Vaads: Global Presence and Impact

Today, Vaads are present in nearly every country with a significant Jewish population. From the
bustling cities of the United States to the remote communities in South America and Asia, Vaads
ensure that kosher standards are upheld worldwide.
1. **Regional Adaptations:** Vaads adapt their practices to fit the unique challenges and needs of
   their regions. This might involve dealing with different food production methods, agricultural
   products, or cultural practices while maintaining the core principles of kosher certification.
2. **Technological Integration:** Modern Vaads leverage technology to streamline certification
   processes, maintain databases of certified products, and facilitate better communication between
   inspectors and businesses. This integration helps ensure transparency and efficiency in
   maintaining kosher standards.

### Why Businesses Should Choose Kosher?

For businesses, obtaining kosher certification can be a strategic decision with numerous benefits:
1. **Consumer Trust:** Hechshers build trust among consumers, assuring them of the product’s
   adherence to high standards of quality and religious compliance.
2. **Competitive Edge:** In a crowded market, kosher certification can distinguish products, making
   them more attractive to both Jewish and non-Jewish consumers.
3. **Ethical Assurance:** The ethical implications of kosher laws, such as humane treatment of
   animals and rigorous cleanliness standards, appeal to a growing demographic of ethically
   conscious consumers.

## Por que Escolher a World Kosher?

Somos a autoridade líder em certificação kosher com reconhecimento internacional e processos
rigorosos de qualidade

🌍

### Reconhecimento Internacional

Certificação aceita em mais de 25 países, incluindo Israel, Estados Unidos, Europa e América Latina

⚡

### Processo Ágil

Certificação em 4-8 semanas com acompanhamento 24/6 e suporte especializado em português

🔒

### Máxima Confiabilidade

Mashgichim qualificados com supervisão rigorosa e relatórios detalhados de conformidade

💼

### Expertise Comprovada

Mais de 1.000 produtos certificados em diversos setores: azeites, conservas, bebidas e muito mais

📞

### Suporte Personalizado

Atendimento direto via WhatsApp e email com consultoria especializada para seu tipo de produto

💰

### Investimento Acessível

Preços competitivos com retorno garantido através do acesso ao mercado kosher mundial

## Perguntas Frequentes

Respostas rápidas para empresas que estão a avaliar certificação kosher.

Quanto tempo demora obter certificação kosher?

Na maioria dos casos, o processo leva entre 4 e 8 semanas, dependendo da complexidade do produto,
ingredientes, linhas de produção e documentação disponível.

O processo interfere na produção diária?

O objetivo é adaptar a supervisão à rotina da fábrica. Em muitos casos não é necessário parar a
produção; quando há kosherização ou produção dedicada, tudo é combinado com antecedência.

A certificação ajuda na exportação?

Sim. A certificação kosher facilita acesso a compradores, distribuidores e mercados que exigem
documentação kosher, especialmente em Israel, EUA, Europa e comunidades judaicas.

Preciso trocar todos os fornecedores?

Nem sempre. Primeiro avaliamos ingredientes e fornecedores existentes. Só sugerimos mudanças quando
algum componente ou processo não permite aprovação kosher.

Qual o primeiro passo?

O primeiro passo é preencher o formulário “Obter Certificado” com dados da empresa, contacto e
produtos. A equipa avalia a viabilidade inicial e orienta a documentação necessária.

## Nossa Equipe Especializada

Profissionais certificados com anos de experiência em supervisão kosher e leis judaicas

👨‍🎓

### Coordenador Rabínico

Responsável Técnico Principal

Especialista em leis kosher com mais de 15 anos de experiência. Responsável pela aprovação final de
todas as certificações e supervisão geral dos processos.

🔍

## Perguntas Frequentes

Respostas rápidas para empresas que estão a avaliar certificação kosher.

Quanto tempo demora obter certificação kosher?

Na maioria dos casos, o processo leva entre 4 e 8 semanas, dependendo da complexidade do produto,
ingredientes, linhas de produção e documentação disponível.

O processo interfere na produção diária?

O objetivo é adaptar a supervisão à rotina da fábrica. Em muitos casos não é necessário parar a
produção; quando há kosherização ou produção dedicada, tudo é combinado com antecedência.

A certificação ajuda na exportação?

Sim. A certificação kosher facilita acesso a compradores, distribuidores e mercados que exigem
documentação kosher, especialmente em Israel, EUA, Europa e comunidades judaicas.

Preciso trocar todos os fornecedores?

Nem sempre. Primeiro avaliamos ingredientes e fornecedores existentes. Só sugerimos mudanças quando
algum componente ou processo não permite aprovação kosher.

Qual o primeiro passo?

O primeiro passo é preencher o formulário “Obter Certificado” com dados da empresa, contacto e
produtos. A equipa avalia a viabilidade inicial e orienta a documentação necessária.

You're not in good hands here when you need help. I visited Dr. Sheldon Freedman, MD only once, and
during that appointment I felt well taken care of. Dr. Freedman was friendly, professional, and
appeared to be competent. After that visit, I needed additional testing by an endocrinologist.
Unfortunately, despite waiting for approximately six weeks, I still had not received the required
referral. Only after repeated follow-up requests was the referral finally provided. Following
further communication problems with Dr. Freedman's office staff, I was surprised to receive a
certified letter informing me that I was being dismissed as a patient. The letter stated that Dr.
Freedman would no longer provide my urologic care and that I should find another physician within 30
days. The end result was extremely disappointing. I paid approximately $300 out of my own pocket for
a medical visit that did not move my treatment forward in any way. Instead, I spent weeks dealing
with administrative delays, poor communication, and ultimately being dismissed as a patient. To be
clear, I have no complaints about Dr. Sheldon Freedman personally. He was courteous, kind, and
competent during my appointment. My experience was negatively affected by what I believe were
serious administrative and communication failures within his office. I strongly suspect Dr. Freedman
may not even be aware of how this situation was handled but of course, I cannot know that for
certain. Read more

In the world of wholesale and B2B commerce, access to reliable suppliers and structured directories

explore thousands of suppliers across multiple categories, helping retailers and entrepreneurs find
the right products to sell both online and offline.

online environment.

Websites such as **[luckyspy.co.uk][11]** are part of this expanding digital landscape,

experiences across different industries.

For businesses operating in wholesale and distribution, understanding these broader trends can offer
valuable insights. By observing how digital platforms grow, attract users, and scale globally,
companies can apply similar principles to their own strategies and remain competitive in a rapidly
changing market.

Ultimately, success in B2B commerce comes from combining reliable sourcing, strategic thinking, and
adaptability. Those who continuously refine their processes and stay open to new opportunities will
